result.Method of Attack: Malicious backdoor embedded in the XZ Utils compression library implementation; Backdoor triggered by specially crafted files leading to potential 'living off the land' attacks
result.Impacted Systems: Rust development environments using liblzma and liblzma-sys crates
result.Attack Vector: Malicious dependency inclusion in liblzma-sys crate version 0.3.2; Distribution via crates.io package manager
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of malicious files enabling exploitation
Yanked versions from crates.io after over 5500 downloads of liblzma and over 1100 downloads of liblzma-sys
